preconditions.description: The number of sentences T must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(M) == 26 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in M)
preconditions.description: The string M must be a permutation of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 100 for S in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence S must be non-empty and contain at most 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_.,!?' for c in S for S in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence S must only contain lowercase letters, uppercase letters, underscores, and specified punctuation symbols.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the English translations of each sentence, separated by newlines.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_.,!?' for c in translated_sentence for translated_sentence in translated_sentences)
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence must only contain lowercase letters, uppercase letters, spaces, and specified punctuation symbols.

postconditions.expression: all(translated_sentence.replace(' ', '_') == S for S, translated_sentence in zip(sentences, translated_sentences))
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence must correspond to the original sentence with underscores replaced by spaces.
